facts.text: Keyesport was named after its first postmaster, Thomas Keyes, whose service helped establish the community in the mid-1800s.
Keyesport sits on the western shore of Carlyle Lake, offering residents scenic waterfront views and access to recreational boating.
The village was platted in 1846 and officially incorporated in 1897, marking its transition from a rural settlement to an organized municipality.
Keyesport lies on the boundary between Clinton and Bond counties, making it a unique cross-county community with shared services.
A 1916 Sanborn Fire Insurance Map details Keyesport’s downtown layout, labeled businesses, and industrial buildings, revealing the town’s early commercial heart.
Historic maps of Keyesport available online let residents and researchers glimpse the town’s past, showing how it evolved from a modest settlement to its current form.
